join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter symbols
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter symbols
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter symbols on|off|percent|min|status


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols status
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter=false, percent=50, min=5


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter is already enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter symbols on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Symbols filter is now enabled.
